title: Modulated periodic activation views for held-out signals
hypothesis: A shared periodic synthesis model whose amplitudes, phases and frequencies are addressed by a compact latent code can reconstruct unseen smooth signals from other signal-code examples with a better quality/actual-bytes/throughput point than a generic latent-concatenation SIREN.
physical_object: One shared synthesis model across 320 one-dimensional signals; trainable model state and one eight-value latent code per signal are serialized and charged.
mirror_coordinate: For four periodic activations, m=z in R^8 is passed through one shared linear modulation map to four amplitudes, four frequency offsets and four phases; these values modulate sin(2π f_k x + φ_k).
logical_multiplicity: Functions for 64 held-out latent codes are synthesized by the same shared model without per-function gradient updates.

task.teacher: Each signal is the sum over four harmonics of a_k(z)/4 * sin(2π f_k(z) x + φ_k(z)), where amplitudes, frequency offsets and phases are smooth tanh-linear functions of the signal's Gaussian latent code. A different deterministic teacher map is generated per seed. Split signal IDs by a seeded permutation; held-out codes are unavailable during shared-model fitting.
task.input_domain: x uniform on [-1,1]; held-out query inputs use disjoint seeded samples.

controls: generic latent-concatenation MLP (x,z)->y, 9-64-64-1 with tanh activations
native direct harmonic conditioning using the same four amplitude/frequency/phase modulation equation as Mirror; this is an exact structural-alias control
private per-held-out-signal harmonic coefficients fit from its 96 support samples
oracle teacher harmonic coefficients, charged in the serialized payload

development.optimizer: Adam; Mirror/native lr 0.01; concatenation lr 0.001; private coefficients lr 0.03
development.selection_metric: held-out signal query NRMSE; actual compressed serialized model+all held-out code bytes; steady-state logical queries/s after one-time deserialization

storage.format: compressed NPZ; FP16 model/code/coefficients and metadata
paid_objects: all 64 held-out eight-dimensional codes or method state

compute.include: shared-model training, private support adaptation, one-time payload loading separately from steady-state query throughput, and synthesis/query operations.

success_gate: Both development seeds: Mirror held-out query NRMSE <=0.05, <=0.80x generic concatenation NRMSE, actual payload <=0.80x concatenation payload, and throughput >=0.80x concatenation. No exact native structural alias may explain the full gain. Passing only qualifies for fresh confirmation.
failure_gate: FAIL if either seed misses a quality/storage/throughput threshold, or if the Mirror result is exactly reproduced by the native direct harmonic control with no incremental Mirror-specific benefit.
boundaries: Synthetic smooth 1D periodic functions only; no natural signal benchmark is claimed.
The teacher is itself generated by smooth amplitude/frequency/phase maps, so results do not establish coverage of arbitrary functions.
A win over generic concatenation is not Mirror-specific if the native direct harmonic control reproduces it.
Held-out signals test code-to-function generalization, not novel factor combinations.
Fresh seeds remain sealed unless both development seeds pass the full gate.
